attributes.powers: For your combat check or your check to defeat a barrier that has the Obstacle trait, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 2d6+1. You may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6; if you have the Dwarf trait, you may recharge it instead. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.
